page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes KVM virtualization to deliver dedicated compute resources. The memory configuration provides a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware. The absence of local NVMe drives and hardware accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, positioning the instance away from high-speed local database caching or intensive machine learning workloads.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g8ise.4xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads such as mid-sized web servers, enterprise applications, containerized microservices, and development environments. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance for sustained workloads without the overhead of shared-core resource contention, making it a stable choice for standard business applications.
